phantom_stampede.name: Lightfoot Pack
phantom_stampede.desc: Fast wolves leave a trail of light that bleeds what crosses it.

howling_legion.name: Howling Legion
howling_legion.desc: Prey your pack fells rises to run with it.

dire_alpha.name: Dire Alpha
dire_alpha.desc: One giant alpha wolf with cleaving bites and heavy bleeding.

murder_storm.name: Wall of Wings
murder_storm.desc: Two rings of ravens circle you in opposite ways: what touches them is pecked, and the rest flee.

dive_bombers.name: Talon Mark
dive_bombers.desc: Ravens dive at the toughest foe and mark it: everything you have hits it 15% harder for 3 s.

spearhead.name: Spearhead
spearhead.desc: A wedge of ravens flies into the thickest crowd and clears a lane.

spirit_tempest.name: Spirit Tempest
spirit_tempest.desc: Rapid bursts of eight homing bolts that explode on their last hit.

soul_lance.name: Soul Lance
soul_lance.desc: One massive bolt that pierces everything in its path.

thunder_judgment.name: Thunder Judgment
thunder_judgment.desc: Periodically strikes every enemy around you. Chains almost without limit.

static_storm.name: Static Storm
static_storm.desc: A constant lightning field strikes random enemies near you.

sanctum_halo.name: Sanctum Halo
sanctum_halo.desc: A wide ring of candles; the ground inside it burns.

judgement_wheel.name: Judgement Wheel
judgement_wheel.desc: Lights burst on contact, then rekindle.
